claims: Turn off and invert the toy car to access the wheels.
Use a pair of tweezers or a small needle to carefully pull out the tangled hair.
Use small scissors to cut the hair if it is wrapped tightly around the axle.
Spin the wheels manually to ensure they move freely after removing the hair.

claims.text: Switch off the toy car and take the batteries out.
Pull hair, thread or carpet fluff off the wheels and axles using tweezers.
Turn the wheels by hand to ensure they move freely before fitting the batteries back.
